independence.reusable_dependencies: generic Meteora/Solana read-only mechanics, authenticated tape reconstruction, provider pacing only
prohibited_inputs: any Robinhood strategy signal, threshold, cohort, score or result
Robinhood/Pons/Ramses backtests, paper outcomes or portfolio allocations
allowed_strategy_inputs: Solana mainnet Meteora DLMM market state
Solana mainnet authenticated DLMM swap/liquidity tape

objective: Maximize expected after-cost SOL return by supplying broad executable liquidity only when authenticated fee production relative to usable local range liquidity is high enough to justify multi-hour exposure.

discovery.acceleration_measurement_source: Meteora /pools/{address}/volume/history with timeframe=5m; require six consecutive recent 5m buckets. volume_5m/fee_5m are the most recent bucket, volume_30m/fee_30m are the sum of those six buckets.
discovery.history_enrichment: Apply to every unique SOL-paired pool returned by the fixed discovery union before acceleration gating; missing/incomplete six-bucket history fails closed.
discovery.completed_bucket_rule: A 5m history bucket is eligible only when timestamp + 300 <= observation_time. The current partial bucket is excluded.
discovery.execution_rule: Use public API fee/volume fields only to order bounded discovery. They never authorize entry. On first sight of each unique SOL pool, preserve completed-bucket context and hand it to authenticated fresh-swap/on-chain evaluation before reading further history when provider capacity permits.

regime.entry_clock: five-minute acceleration is regime-only; a new finalized authenticated Meteora DLMM swap after compatibility screening starts the entry-observation clock

fresh_swap_trigger.rule: A completed public fee/volume bucket may keep a candidate in the bounded discovery queue, but entry authorization begins only after a new authenticated finalized DLMM swap. Capture fresh state and one exact 12-second warmup; public acceleration is telemetry only.

position.entry_inventory_conversion: convert 50% of SOL capital to the non-SOL token on the authenticated virtual entry state, then place SOL below/above active as appropriate and token on the opposite side
position.distribution: equal weight within each side of the range
position.rebalance: none_in_v1; withdraw instead when the thesis fails

range.selection: broad centered executable range sized to survive multi-hour exposure without unnecessary dilution
range.movement_model: warmup active-bin excursion may widen the range within the frozen 26-50 half-width band; it may not narrow below the robust broad-range floor.

warmup_alignment.trigger: first fresh authenticated finalized DLMM swap while frozen acceleration regime remains true
warmup_alignment.rule: The qualifying warmup starts only after a fresh authenticated finalized swap and remains exactly 12 seconds. A zero-swap post-trigger warmup is a valid rejection.

range.research_band_note: The historical 51-100-bin band maps to 52-100 supplied bins here because the mechanically modeled centered range deliberately excludes the active bin to avoid unmodeled active-bin composition fees.

qualification.expected_net_definition: projected exact-range fee capture over the 4h minimum core hold - 400000 lamports modeled network cost - 50%-inventory stress unwind loss; must be strictly positive
qualification.ranking_metric: authenticated fee production / executable local range liquidity, 24h-normalized
unchanged_hard_risk_gates: position sizing from local executable depth
fresh authenticated finalized swap and exact 12-second warmup

fee_model.range_fee_capture: authenticated warmup LP fees from swaps intersecting the proposed range, converted to SOL at authenticated bin prices
fee_model.dynamic_fee_uplift_role: recorded context and exit-state feature; not a hard entry gate
fee_model.hard_entry_economic_test: authenticated_fee_density_24h_pct >= 5.0 AND projected 4h exact-range fee capture - 400000 lamports network cost - stress unwind loss > 0
fee_model.metric_boundary: Uses only pre-entry authenticated finalized swap tape and executable local range liquidity. Public Meteora feePerTvl24h and current API fee/TVL fields are not entry evidence.
fee_model.historical_mapping: The frozen 5%/day threshold preserves the broad historical positive regime only after its unit is explicitly redefined in authenticated local-liquidity terms; it is not a direct trust of the retrospective API field.

flow_model.two_way_role: hard entry gate; event-driven exit if subsequent flow becomes persistently one-way with high drift

conditions: active price reaches within 2 bins of either range boundary (immediate hard-risk exit)
executable non-SOL inventory value exceeds 60% of initial capital (immediate hard-risk exit)
recent verified flow has >=2 swaps, two_way_balance <0.25 and drift_ratio >0.75 (immediate adverse-selection exit)
after the 4h core hold, recent fee density remains below 50% of entry authenticated fee density for at least 2 consecutive verified 300s segments
after the 4h core hold, recent volume rate remains below 50% of entry warmup volume rate for at least 2 consecutive verified 300s segments
stress-unwind or executable-mark evidence becomes unavailable
exit.settlement: withdraw all liquidity and liquidate residual non-SOL inventory to SOL on the authenticated virtual state

costs.entry_inventory_swap_fee_and_slippage: modeled directly by the virtual DLMM swap

deferred_modes.fee_earning_directional_conversion: separate future strategy; not mixed into this core market-making rule
deferred_modes.core_major_pair_harvester: separate future lower-return/high-capacity sleeve after the opportunistic rule is characterized
deferred_modes.competitive_reallocation_exit: deferred until competing pools can be authenticated contemporaneously without weakening the evidence boundary

amendment_history.reason: Explicitly prohibit all Robinhood/Pons/Ramses strategy, data, provider, cohort and outcome inputs before any prospective Solana DLMM outcome.

Repair measurement source before any on-chain prospective attempt: /pools TimeWindowData does not expose 5m values; compute the already-frozen 5m/30m acceleration ratios from six dedicated 5m history buckets.
Exclude incomplete current 5-minute history bucket from acceleration measurement; prior run compared a partial bucket against completed history and made the discovery gate artificially strict.

Improve warmup synchronization without changing strategy thresholds: retry a fresh 12-second warmup only after a verified zero-swap window, up to five windows, rechecking the same frozen acceleration gates before every retry.

Expand only mechanically equivalent pool/token support based on exact rejected-pool census: metadata-only Token-2022 plus optional ImmutableOwner vaults, and classic mint authority when freeze authority is absent. Behavioral Token-2022 extensions and OnlyY fee mode remain fail-closed.
Remove stale-event latency by streaming each acceleration-qualified pool directly into fresh on-chain warmup, and repair missing-start-boundary evidence with bounded paginated signature census.

Implement four prespecified refinements: completed-5m acceleration becomes regime-only; unsupported mechanics are screened before attempt budget; fresh authenticated finalized swap triggers the exact 12s warmup; dynamic-fee uplift becomes context-only while expected net after unwind and costs remains the hard fee/economic gate.

Execution-certification overlay widens regime and flow admission, removes mandatory reversal, and permits bounded modeled loss so natural paper lifecycle machinery can be exercised before profitability tightening.

Machinery-proof-only revision admits authenticated one-way warmups and bounded modeled losses observed in execution certification so a natural paper DLMM lifecycle can exercise reserve, entry, monitoring, unwind and settlement. Fresh-swap authentication, exact warmup, capacity, drift, stress-unwind, costs, position size, finality, accounting and paper-only authority remain unchanged.

Make the declared 4-hour minimum non-risk hold executable. Range-boundary, severe inventory-imbalance and severe one-way-drift exits remain immediate; fee-density and volume collapse become eligible only after the core hold and require two consecutive verified 300-second segments.

safe_token_programs: Token-2022 only when mint extensions are MetadataPointer/TokenMetadata and vault extensions are absent or ImmutableOwner
support_layer.classic_mint_authority: allowed mechanically only when freeze authority is absent; issuer mint authority is surfaced in every pre-entry record
support_layer.token2022_behavioral_extensions: fail_closed including TransferFeeConfig/Amount, TransferHook, Pausable, PermanentDelegate, NonTransferable, DefaultAccountState, ConfidentialTransfer and unknown extensions
support_layer.collect_fee_mode_1_only_y: fail_closed until exact fee-growth/swap accounting is implemented
support_layer.function_types: unchanged; existing supported function-type set retained
support_layer.compatibility_budget_rule: Full structural/token/fee-mode compatibility validation occurs before a pool increments the prospective max_attempted_pools counter. Unsupported configurations are recorded separately and never consume the 48 economic-attempt budget.

evidence_acquisition.signature_census: Paginate finalized getSignaturesForAddress up to 16 pages of 64 rows until a row at or before the authenticated start slot proves the lower boundary.
evidence_acquisition.replay_input: All successful finalized transactions in (start_slot,end_slot] plus one finalized lower-bound witness; newer-than-end rows are scheduling noise.

network_identity.rule: Prove Solana mainnet identity once per research run with up to 3 bounded session attempts; rotated sessions reuse that proof and do not independently call getGenesisHash.

checkpointing.rule: Atomically checkpoint discovery classifications, compatibility rejections, candidate terminal states, qualification decisions, lifecycles, provider telemetry, and final state. Terminal process failures augment rather than replace the last checkpoint.

prospective_runtime.rule: Stop gracefully at the experiment deadline and preserve partial evidence; do not use a job cancellation as the experiment boundary.

rpc_429_efficiency.signature_polling: One getSignaturesForAddress read per fresh-swap poll. The same response supplies both new-signature discovery and the finalized head cursor; the previous second head-only request is removed.
rpc_429_efficiency.shared_backoff: All bounded Alchemy RPC sessions share one adaptive 429 cooldown via the run-scoped pacer. Consecutive 429s increase cooldown up to 30 seconds; sustained successful transports decay the pressure level.
rpc_429_efficiency.candidate_semantics: HTTP 429 during signatures, transactions, fresh pool state, warmup reconstruction, or lifecycle evidence is transport pressure and is retried within bounded recovery/deadline rules. It is not an economic candidate rejection.
rpc_429_efficiency.cursor_safety: If transaction retrieval is rate-limited after signatures are discovered, the cursor is not advanced; those signatures are retried.

rpc_429_recovery.rule: Fresh-swap polling uses one getSignaturesForAddress read per poll; the returned finalized head advances the non-swap cursor. A 429 during signature or transaction acquisition is transport pressure, not a candidate failure. All rotated Alchemy sessions share one adaptive cooldown state. A rate-limited getTransaction does not advance the cursor, so the exact signatures are retried.
